title: SDLC Acceptance Criterion Identifier v1
description: The canonical identifier of an acceptance criterion declared under an authoritative work-item.json requirement.
$comment: AcceptanceCriterionIdentifier has the exact form {WorkItemId}_REQ_{three-or-more-digit-requirement-number}_AC_{three-or-more-digit-criterion-number}. Local semantic resolution selects exactly one matching requirements.items[].acceptanceCriteria[] object from the named work-item.json.
